archetypes.name: dyn-stage-all-dirty-intersect
archetypes.rationale: Verify commit-fixes --stage-all intersects collected paths with porcelain dirty paths and noops when the intersection is empty.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect _commit_fixes_stage_all and _porcelain_dirty_paths in review_and_fix.py. Confirm dirty-path intersection preserves collected order, uses git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all, writes only the dirty subset to review-fix-stage-paths.txt, and returns COMMIT_OUTCOME=noop without invoking git commit when the intersection is empty. Check Git-fixture tests cover clean collected paths, partial dirty subsets with unrelated baselines unstaged, and nested untracked files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
